{{Top|leg}}
A '''flat''' was a style, or type, of artwork.

[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Glovstoak]] was in possession of a number of such pieces, which were on public display in his palace. Although grandiose, they were relatively cheap, and within the legitimate means of Glovstoak. The display of flats, sculptures, [[tressle]]s, and [[volman]]s that Glovstoak owned was a ruse meant to draw away suspicion from the private collection of art he had assembled using embezzled [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tax revenue.
